question: Why did Switzerland keep trading with Nazi Germany?
answer: Switzerland was surrounded and dependent on imports from Germany and Italy, so it traded to survive. Its banks also bought Reich gold that it knew was partly taken from occupied countries and Holocaust victims, and they kept Nazi leaders' money, which was self-interest. Each fact can be weighed as survival or self-interest.
move: Swiss wartime neutrality was chiaroscuro: survival and profit, side by side.
